text_block_list.text:
On a day off while taking a walk,
I bumped in to 
Narita Top Road.
She seemed excited about something.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the time to get from the dorm to
the station is fine!
Looks like there will be plenty 
of time. ――Right,
let's head to the station.
choice_data_list: Heading somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san! Yeah,
I was planning on going to the amusement
park! 
……Though today is just a trial run.
choice_data_list: A trial run for the amusement park……?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Next time,
I was planning on going with some
friends, and I was put in charge of this.
So I was thinking 
of getting a preview and preparing for it!

She said it matter-of-factly……but it was
probably 
rough to do this alone. That said,
if I told her 
I wanted to help, she'd probably decline――
choice_data_list: Sounds fun. Mind if I tag along today?
Sounds fun. Mind if I tag along today?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
With Trainer-san? ……Ah,
sorta like a change of pace? 
But, if you go with me,
you won't be able to see much――
choice_data_list: But it'll be more fun!
But it'll be more fun!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu,
you're right!
If I looked around with Trainer-san 
I could spend the whole day having fun!
Let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
what I wanted to check out today was…… 
the schedule for the attractions and how
crowded it would be.
I'll use that to plan for the day itself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's looking forward to the parade,
so we'll 
definitely have to check that out.
I'll have to 
create a course that takes the parade in to
account.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
……Okaaay,
the parade times are……the first one is at
11:30. Which 
means we won't be able to line up for other
attractions, huh……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So maybe souvenirs first……but,
then we have to carry them around.
choice_data_list: How about having an early lunch?

text_block_list.text:
The parade ended just around lunch time.
Around that time,
the restaurants would start to get crowded
and 
the lines for the popular attractions might
die down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see……! By doing that,
we can avoid the crowds 
for lunch and the attractions!
Looks like it'll 
be easier to get on the popular attractions,
too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Then,
next up……we need to find a restaurant for
lunch, right!? 
I'll need to keep a few of the places in
mind!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This shop looks good!
You can see the parade course 
from the window,
so you can see how crowded it will be!
choice_data_list: A seat near the exit might be best

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're right,
if possible I want to see if we can request
seats. 
Now, let's order something and see how long
it takes!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, it's tasty……! But,
that was unexpected. 
To think I'd have trouble deciding after
looking at the menu!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I was still having a hard time deciding,
even 
after Trainer-san had already ordered.
Looks 
like I need to consider how long it'll take
to decide.
choice_data_list: Want a bite?

text_block_list.text:
I hadn't touched it yet,
so I took my knife 
and cut a piece off,
putting it on her plate.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
! Thanks alot! I see,
sharing……! If we did that,
then we wouldn't 
have to worry over what to order. Fufu,
it sounds like a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright,
looks like we've found a good spot! 
There's nothing blocking the view here!
choice_data_list: There might be more space over there

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's true……looks like there's plenty of
space over there. 
That might be a good spot too……――Ah!
The parade's here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Waaa! At the front is the Carrot Queen! 
Her outfit's really cute!
The float looks really grand too……!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The dancers and the music are really sparkly
too…… 
Ah, looks like you can participate in the
dance too!
choice_data_list: Let's try it out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
'Round and 'round and 'round……fufuu! 
Seeing Trainer-san dancing is pretty unusual!
Fufufu!

We enjoyed the parade to its fullest.
Right after that, we went 
to the most popular attraction in the park,
the Jet Coaster.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even the Jet Coaster is crowded during lunch
since it's so popular, huh. ――Yeah,
I guess that means 
after the parade is the Big Thunder
Mountain!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
One of my classmates said that it's easy to
get 『Motion Sick』 on it so 
……I thought it might be better to check it
out beforehand!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wa, wa, wa, wa-……! 
L-look at that,
the people down there are waving……H-heeeey!
Haha……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hii-, wai-……iyaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
……S-sorry,
it wasn't supposed to be like this…… 
Ugghh……
choice_data_list: Are you okay? We can rest over at――

text_block_list.text:
I open the park map and try to find a place
to take a break.
Looks like there are some benches around
the nearby pond.
I supported her as we made our way there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: …………Huuu……
choice_data_list: Feeling better?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks to you. 
I'm sorry for bothering you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
………… 
……Trainer-san, um……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Are you having fun?
choice_data_list: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I mean, ever since this morning,
you've spent all day 
with me……I was thinking it would be a good
change of pace. But,
you haven't really been having fun right?
choice_data_list: It's fun because I'm with you
It's fun because I'm with you

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But, I've just been one-sidedly having you
help me. 
Am I not being a bother……?
choice_data_list: No. ――Is it a burden for you?
No. ――Is it a burden for you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Not even a little bit! 
As the one in charge,
I decided to do this myself!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because I want everyone to enjoy it to the
fullest! 
That makes it worth doing! It's something I,
myself, want to do!
choice_data_list: It's the same for me

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ……The same?

Being able to devote yourself to someone else.
And on top of that,
feeling that it's worth doing.
I tell Narita Top Road 
that I think she's amazing to be able to
feel like that.

That's why I wanted her to see it through.
I wanted 
her to live up to everyone's expectations.
But, if it was hard for her to do it alone
then――
choice_data_list: Don't hesitate to rely on me
Don't hesitate to rely on me

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
choice_data_list: Things'll go smoother with both of...
Things'll go smoother with both of...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: With both of us…………Ah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(……That's right. More so than by myself. 
With two of us,
we'll be able come up with better
ideas……!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(So we can make this as fun as we can for
everyone. 
――It's fine to borrow someone else's
strength!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ……Then if Trainer-san is saying that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Can I ask you to continue accompanying me?
choice_data_list: Gladly!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! 
Well then,
next up……let's go to the Haunted Halls!

I followed after Narita Top Road who
had a 
bright and cheerful smile on her face.
The time 
we spent brainstorming ideas was very
productive.
